method: The frozen checker was run against a fresh tester ISO built from the parent. Six native QEMU geometries ran with matching image measurements. Two additional boots deliberately mismatched the parent measurement. The same candidate cases came from the previously preserved frozen-head runs. The only harness adaptations were QMP transport over stdio and assigning single geometries to separate native PCP workers. Nominal 1x; each P6 dimension was verified for the replay. A rejecting checker exits 1 even when the guest shut down cleanly.
replay: With Python 3, run python3 -IB execution/replay.py <checkout of 62c24cc> <archive root>. Compare the printed per-size verdicts with results in readback.json. Each capture is decoded directly using the frozen font and the displayed rows are compared with the retained transcripts.
